tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. The whole product sits on this near-black; nothing lighter than canvas-overlay is ever a full-bleed surface.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the Brief body. One step up from canvas; separated from it by line, never by shadow.

tokens.name: canvas-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, popovers, the paywall sheet, hover state of a card.

tokens.name: canvas-inset
tokens.usage: Receipt tables, raw evidence excerpts, code, the radar field. Sits below canvas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between and around panels. Decorative: not required to meet 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: control outlines, the locked SignalCard, table header rules, the confidence track. 3.1:1 on canvas, 3.0:1 on canvas-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on canvas, canvas-raised, canvas-overlay and canvas-inset (16.4:1 on canvas). Also the target/radar motif and the lock ring.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, evidence sources, table row text on any canvas surface (8.3:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata at 13px+ only (ticks, byline, disabled text): 4.3:1 on canvas, 4.1:1 on canvas-raised. Never for body copy or anything a judge must read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a solid ink fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Verified-positive and commercial-success states only: PASS checks, PUBLISH decision, PAID and DELIVERED order states, LIVE dot. Text at 13px+ on canvas/canvas-raised (7.6:1) and on verified-fill (6.1:1).

tokens.name: verified-fill
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind verified text or a verified badge. Always paired with a verified border or text; never as a plain surface.

tokens.name: on-verified
tokens.usage: Text on a solid verified fill (reserved; no current component uses a solid verified fill).

tokens.name: uncertain
tokens.usage: Uncertainty and estimation: MEDIUM/LOW confidence, gate cap, unknowns, UNKNOWN checks, CACHED data, TESTNET label, estimated costs and contribution, PAYMENT_PENDING, PAYMENT_UNKNOWN, RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Text at 13px+ on canvas surfaces (8.7:1) and on uncertain-fill (7.0:1).

tokens.name: uncertain-fill
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind uncertain text or badges. Always paired with uncertain border or text.

tokens.name: invalid
tokens.usage: Failed or untrusted: FAIL checks, STALE evidence, PAYMENT_FAILED, DELIVERY_FAILED, REJECT gate decision, expired quote. Text at 13px+ on canvas surfaces (5.6:1; 4.9:1 on canvas-overlay) and on invalid-fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: invalid-fill
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind invalid text or badges. Always paired with invalid border or text.

tokens.name: fixture
tokens.usage: The FIXTURE provenance label and anything synthetic or replayed. One flat lavender, never a gradient; always with the word FIXTURE beside it (9.2:1 on canvas, 7.7:1 on fixture-fill).

tokens.name: fixture-fill
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind the FIXTURE label and a fixture banner in the EvidenceDrawer.

tokens.name: historical
tokens.usage: The HISTORICAL provenance label: settled, past data. Alias of ink-secondary so history never reads as a state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px so it sits on the surface around the control, on every interactive element (16.4:1 on canvas, 15:1 on canvas-overlay). Alias-free so it never changes with the accent.

tokens.name: radar-sweep
tokens.usage: The translucent sweep wedge and lock-on halo in the radar field. Decorative only.

tokens.name: radar-grid
tokens.usage: Rings and crosshair of the radar field on canvas-inset. Decorative only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The product name on the hero and the Brief title on a paywall. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the Brief headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a Brief, drawer and panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The issuer applied a dividend rebase; the on-chain multiplier moved from 1.000000 to 1.004871 at block 12 884 102.
styles.usage: Brief prose, card reasons, drawer summaries. Max measure 68ch.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Issuer record and on-chain read agree; the reference price is CACHED.
styles.usage: Dense list text, timeline entries, receipt notes. Set in ink or ink-secondary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels, badge text, column headers. Always uppercase; always ink-secondary or a state colour.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one big number on a panel: price, multiplier change, contribution estimate. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Timestamps, hashes, identifiers, amounts, multipliers, tool names, symbols, enum values, table cells. Tabular figures on.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Truncated hashes, tick labels, footnotes in receipts. Set in ink-secondary; never ink-muted below 13px.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Cards pad 16, panels 24, screens gutter 24 (16 on phones).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge inner padding, gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, between a label and its value, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows: timeline entries, receipt lines, SignalCard header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone gutter, gap between cards in the feed.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, desktop gutter, gap between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Brief section spacing, paywall sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero vertical rhythm, space around the radar field.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, table cells, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, drawers, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the confidence ring, radar rings, the lock reticle.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. Surfaces are separated by line, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only the EvidenceDrawer and the BriefPaywall sheet when they float over the canvas.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status and provenance dots.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button and input height.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: ConfidenceIndicator ring diameter (compact); 96px in the Brief header. Same size as the 56px target mark.

tokens.name: size-radar
tokens.usage: Radar field diameter in the hero on desktop; 280px on phones.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of Brief prose.
